enhanced_commands.config.entity_selector: Entity selector parsing
Accept option name alias
When typing options in the entity selector, aliases will be allowed, such as 'c' and 'm'. For example, '%1$s' will be equivalent to '%2$s'.
Allow quoted advancement criterion name

When typing the name of an advancement criterion in the entity selector, allow quoted strings to avoid the issue that a criterion may be unable because it contains special characters such as space. For example, %1$s will be valid.
Allow level argument inversion
The '%1$s' argument in the entity selector will allow inversion. For example, '%2$s' will be valid.
Allow directly inputting predicate JSON
When typing a loot table predicate, allow directly typing JSON to specify a predicate instead of using its ID.
Allow multiple game modes
Allow selecting multiple game modes like '%1$s'.
Allow multiple types
Allow selecting multiple types such as '%1$s'.
Allow negative instance for nearest
When parsing %1$s, if '%2$s' parameter is not specified, allow using negative values for furthest entities. For example, '%3$s' will be equivalent to '%4$s'.
Allow score inversion
When typing scores, allow inverting the expected value of score. For example, '%1$s'.
Configs affecting the parsing of entity selector
Display detailed reason of inapplicable entity selector option

When parsing entity selectors, when some options that can be identified are not applicable for some reason, try to describe the reason in detail, such as the option is only applicable to players, or is already used, instead of merely stating that the option is not applicable here.
Fix entity type tag suggestion
When typing entity type tags, avoid stepping into the next parsing without completing input which may lead to the issue that suggestions are not displayed.
Improved entity type suggestion
When suggesting entity type ids, their translatable names are also provided, which will be shown then mouse hovered on suggestions.
Show suggestions of advancement criteria
When typing an advancement criterion in the entity selector (for example %1$s), show suggestions of entity criterion.
Show advancement suggestions
When typing advancements IDs (for example %1$s), offer suggestions of advancement IDs.
Show predicate suggestions
When typing a loot table predicate in the entity selector (which is the %1$s option), show suggestions of the predicate ID.
Display score objective suggestions
When typing score objectives (such as %1$s), show suggestions of score objectives.
enhanced_commands.config.general_parsing: When parsing game modes, allow using their aliases, which applies to %1$s command and the '%2$s' parameter in the entity selector.
The parsing process affecting various parts in commands.
When parsing IDs, if the ID contains an error, a more detailed exception message will be displayed, including notifying the ID may contain upper-case letters.
When parsing a registry entry, display more detailed error message.
When parsing IDs, if there is an upper-case letter, parsing will continue and display corresponding the exception message, instead of notifying unknown argument.
Improve the parsing of NBT path. In vanilla, the parsing of the whole NBT path stops until meeting a space, which may cause some problems in this mod. This option is used to modify this behavior.

When displaying suggestions of ID, if the namespace is not typed, non-vanilla namespaced entries will be also suggested. For example, when typing a biome tag, if '%1$s' is typed, '%2$s' may be suggested.
When displaying suggestions of IDs, omit the default name space. For example, when typing a block ID, the suggestion will be "%1$s" instead of "%2$s".
